provenance.baselineSource: archived original runtime inputs; extension endpoint-only patch; no current product source substituted
provenance.chromeDistribution: Chrome for Testing win64; official version/download recorded after Browser.getVersion
provenance.harnessScope: current worktree instrumentation; not the original product binary

method.commandLatencyScope: before host process launch to successful process wait after stdout pipe drained; includes launch/IPC/render/pipe; not first-response/connect decomposition
method.cpuCounterCaveat: CDP cpuTime and Windows GetProcessTimes are independent counters and disagree materially on this host for short bursts; raw counters/cycles are retained. PID verification does not claim agreement or establish an overhead improvement.
method.cpuUnits: SystemInfo cumulative process cpuTime seconds; percent is delta / wall window * 100 of one logical core; no overhead subtraction
method.fixture: static synthetic inventory / 100 rows / 101 controls / no page script or external assets
method.idleScope: warm attached bridge idle after snapshot; <=3 minute debugger lease; no 10-minute cold-idle claim
method.instrumentation: one root browser WebSocket; setup tracing stopped and page CDP session detached before sampling; two SystemInfo.getProcessInfo calls per interval plus before/after inventory/attachment checks outside interval
method.osCpuUnits: GetProcessTimes raw 100ns kernel/user counters; bracketing window reported separately
method.outputCounting: exact text stdout with newline; hash and ordinary-text BPE counted after CPU interval; no raw page output persisted
method.processCountScope: owned archived bridge daemon; transient snapshot children have exited; benchmark runner and one monitoring browser socket are separate test infrastructure
method.rendererMapping: setup-only Chrome trace main frame URL+frame -> processId; OS executable, parent PID and creation time cross-check; SystemInfo renderer membership checked before/after
method.scenarioIsolation: fresh Chrome for Testing profile per scenario; ten repeated windows in the same page; no navigating during sampling
method.statistics: nearest-rank p50/p95; sequential fixed scenario order; no significance or optimization claim

unavailable.cdpCallsPerCommand: original extension has no per-method counter; no inferred counts or runtime shim used in this baseline
unavailable.coldIdleObserversAndCache: 10-minute detach/observer/cache behavior not measured in these warm-idle windows
unavailable.connectLatency: separate R0-S4 connect-spike-windows.json is a current harness probe; not an original bridge first-CDP-response measurement
unavailable.hostedCI: local Windows run; R0-06 Linux hosted CI dependency is still unverified
unavailable.injectedPageCoreIdle: original commit has no page core; bridge-idle is the available original-engine counterpart, not an injected page-core result
unavailable.pageCoreMemory: no original isolated page core to measure; worker heap is not a substitute
unavailable.productionDirectCommands: new direct snapshot/query runtime is not migrated; archived bridge is measured here
unavailable.recoveryAndConformance: R0-08/R5-17 fault matrix and R6-07 Flow conformance are separate acceptance suites
unavailable.resumeAndCheckpoints: production fast/slow resume and checkpoint store do not exist at original commit
unavailable.successfulTaskTokens: query output BPE is not total tokens per successful agent task; R4-12 task suite remains required
